content.utf8:
screen_schema = 2
id = "vendor.semantic.review"
title = "Semantic Continuation Review"
route = "vendor.semantic.open"
initial_focus = "list"
focus_order = ["list"]

[[resources]]
type_id = "vendor.change"
schema_version = 1
semantic_key = "semantic-key"

[[resources.fields]]
id = "semantic-key"
label = "Semantic key"
type = "string"
required = true

[[overlays]]
kind = "confirmation"

[[bindings]]
context = "dashboard"
action = "vendor.semantic.deploy"

[[panels]]
id = "list"
type = "vendor.semantic.list"
focusable = true
required = true

[[panels.ports]]
id = "selection"
direction = "output"
owner = "vendor.semantic.review"
type_id = "vendor.change@1"
required = false
retained = false

[[panels]]
id = "detail"
type = "vendor.semantic.detail"
focusable = false
required = false

[[panels.ports]]
id = "subject"
direction = "input"
owner = "vendor.semantic.review"
type_id = "vendor.change@1"
required = false
retained = false

[[panels.ports]]
id = "subject-b"
direction = "input"
owner = "vendor.semantic.review"
type_id = "vendor.change@1"
required = false
retained = false

[layout]
type = "split"
axis = "horizontal"

[[layout.children]]
min = 20
collapsible = false
size = { weight = 1 }
node = { type = "leaf", panel = "list" }

[[layout.children]]
min = 20
collapsible = true
collapse_priority = 0
size = { weight = 1 }
node = { type = "leaf", panel = "detail" }

[[relationships]]
kind = "scope"
source = "list.selection"
target = "detail.subject"

[[relationships]]
kind = "scope"
source = "list.selection"
target = "detail.subject-b"

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
read -r hello
process_generation=$(printf '%s\n' "$hello" | sed -n 's/.*"generation":\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
printf '%s\n' '{"protocol":1,"type":"hello-ack","request_id":"p-100001","generation":'"$process_generation"',"payload":{"provider_name":"semantic-continuation","protocol":1}}'
read -r configure
printf '%s\n' '{"protocol":1,"type":"ready","request_id":"p-100002","generation":'"$process_generation"',"payload":{"capabilities":["actions","panels"]}}'
read -r open
case "$open" in *'"action_id":"vendor.semantic.open"'*) ;; *) exit 41 ;; esac
printf '%s\n' '{"protocol":1,"type":"outcome","request_id":"p-100003","generation":'"$process_generation"',"payload":{"kind":"navigate","route_id":"vendor.semantic.open","activation":{}}}'
read -r activate
panel_instance_id=$(printf '%s\n' "$activate" | sed -n 's/.*"panel_instance_id":\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
panel_generation=$(printf '%s\n' "$activate" | sed -n 's/.*"generation":\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
printf '%s\n' '{"protocol":1,"type":"panel-snapshot","request_id":"p-100004","generation":'"$process_generation"',"payload":{"model_schema":1,"panel_instance_id":'"$panel_instance_id"',"generation":'"$panel_generation"',"revision":1,"kind":"list","title":"Typed semantic resources","loading":false,"action_affordances":[],"body":{"kind":"list","items":[{"id":"alpha","label":"Alpha resource","actions":[]},{"id":"beta","label":"Beta resource","actions":[]}],"selected_id":"alpha"}}}'
read -r activate_detail
detail_instance_id=$(printf '%s\n' "$activate_detail" | sed -n 's/.*"panel_instance_id":\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
detail_generation=$(printf '%s\n' "$activate_detail" | sed -n 's/.*"generation":\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
printf '%s\n' '{"protocol":1,"type":"panel-snapshot","request_id":"p-100005","generation":'"$process_generation"',"payload":{"model_schema":1,"panel_instance_id":'"$detail_instance_id"',"generation":'"$detail_generation"',"revision":1,"kind":"list","title":"Typed relationship target","loading":false,"action_affordances":[],"body":{"kind":"list","items":[{"id":"alpha","label":"Alpha target","actions":[]}],"selected_id":"alpha"}}}'
read -r selected_beta_initial
case "$selected_beta_initial" in *'"type":"panel-event"'*'"event":{"kind":"selected","id":"beta"}'*) ;; *) exit 47 ;; esac
read -r selected_alpha_initial
case "$selected_alpha_initial" in *'"type":"panel-event"'*'"event":{"kind":"selected","id":"alpha"}'*) ;; *) exit 48 ;; esac
read -r invocation_a
case "$invocation_a" in *'"action_id":"vendor.semantic.deploy"'*'"arguments":{}'*'"resource_refs":{"detail.subject"'*'"list.selection"'*) ;; *) exit 42 ;; esac
case "$invocation_a" in *'"detail.subject-b"'*) ;; *) exit 49 ;; esac
owner_count=$(printf '%s\n' "$invocation_a" | grep -o '"owner-id"' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
alpha_count=$(printf '%s\n' "$invocation_a" | grep -o '"semantic-key":{"type":"string","value":"alpha"}' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
[ "$owner_count" = 3 ] && [ "$alpha_count" = 6 ] || exit 43
case "$invocation_a" in *'"continuation"'*) exit 44 ;; esac
printf '%s\n' 'invocation A exact typed context: list.selection,detail.subject,detail.subject-b=alpha' > invocation-a.txt
read -r selected_beta
case "$selected_beta" in *'"type":"panel-event"'*'"revision":1'*'"event":{"kind":"selected","id":"beta"}'*) ;; *) exit 45 ;; esac
printf '%s\n' 'semantic head changed: alpha->beta' > semantic-head.txt
printf '%s\n' '{"protocol":1,"type":"outcome","request_id":"p-100006","generation":'"$process_generation"',"payload":{"kind":"request-host-confirmation","confirmation_id":"semantic.deploy.alpha","title":"Confirm alpha deployment?","body":"The selected semantic resource may have changed.","confirm_label":"Deploy alpha","destructive":true,"continuation_schema":[]}}'
if read -r invocation_b; then
  case "$invocation_b" in
    *'"type":"shutdown"'*)
      printf '%s\n' '{"protocol":1,"type":"shutdown-ack","request_id":"p-100007","generation":'"$process_generation"',"payload":{}}'
      exit 0
      ;;
    *)
      printf '%s\n' "$invocation_b" > invocation-b.txt
      exit 46
      ;;
  esac
fi
